blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: telbare en ontelbare zelfstandige naamwoorden herkennen
hoeveelheden aangeven met much, many, a lot of, a few, a little

blocks.text: Telbare woorden hebben een meervoud: an apple, two apples. Ontelbare woorden niet: water, money, information. Ze krijgen geen a of an en geen -s, en het werkwoord staat in het enkelvoud.

blocks.title: Ontelbaar in het Engels, telbaar in het Nederlands
Een advies = a piece of advice
blocks.text: Voor één exemplaar van iets ontelbaars zeg je a piece of: a piece of advice (een advies), a piece of furniture (een meubel), a piece of information. Ook: Your hair is long; The news is good; I need some information, nooit informations.

head: Gebruik
Voorbeeld
rows: There is some milk. I've got some friends here.
Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
There isn't any milk. I haven't got any money.
Are there any shops near here?
There's no milk. = There isn't any milk.

blocks.title: something, anything, nothing
blocks.text: Dezelfde regel geldt voor something / anything / nothing, somebody / anybody / nobody en somewhere / anywhere / nowhere: I didn't see anything. Is anybody there? There's nobody here.

head: Telbaar
Ontelbaar
Voorbeeld
rows: How many people? Not much time.
a lot of friends, a lot of money
a few days, a little sugar
How many eggs? How much milk?

blocks.title: How much is it? — Hoeveel kost het?
blocks.text: Bij prijzen gebruik je altijd How much, ook al tel je euro's: How much is it? How much does it cost?

head: Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: There's too much sugar. There are too many cars.
Er zit te veel suiker in. Er zijn te veel auto's.

blocks.title: enough achter een bijvoeglijk naamwoord
blocks.text: enough staat na een bijvoeglijk naamwoord (big enough), maar vóór een zelfstandig naamwoord (enough money). Precies zoals het Nederlandse groot genoeg en genoeg geld.

rows: Can you give me an advice?
Can you give me some advice?
I have a lot of friends.
In een bevestigende zin: a lot of.

blocks.text: Vul het juiste woord in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.full: How much sugar do you want?
How many brothers have you got?

items.q: Can I have ______ milk in my tea?
items.full: Can I have a little milk in my tea?

items.q: This bag is ______ heavy. I can't carry it.
items.full: This bag is too heavy. I can't carry it.
He isn't old enough to drive.

items.q: She gave me a good piece of ______.
items.full: She gave me a good piece of advice.
Is there anything in the fridge?
The news is very good today.

items.q: There were ______ many people at the party.
items.full: There were too many people at the party.

items.q: Kun je me wat advies geven?
items.a: Can you give me some advice?
